blockingPrinciple: A calculator is disabled where the controlling geometry or installation rule cannot be established from the supplied documents.

items.issue: The slab drawing combines an overall +10 to +30 mm opening with 5 to 20 mm edge clearances.
items.decision: Store overall oversize and per-edge constraints separately; do not assume central positioning.

items.issue: Ordinary masonry pages do not publish a complete numerical opening rule.
items.decision: Keep those methods guidance-only unless the official drawing or hole-sizing logic is available.

items.issue: Type A light-wall opening is +75 in the installation booklet and +70 in the short datasheet.
items.decision: Use +75 provisionally and show an audit warning.

items.issue: Published tables are based on centralised installation but the detailed AFS constraints permit non-central positioning.
items.decision: Store table result and edge-limit logic separately; maximum case-to-edge clearance 130 mm, recommended batt space 25 mm.

items.issue: Nominal duct and casing/frame dimensions are not interchangeable.
items.decision: Every setting-out calculation must identify its geometry reference explicitly.

entries.summary: Added method-specific builder setting-out mapping and Lindab engineering database for FNC1, WH25, WH45, WK25, WK45 and WKS25. FNC1U remains locked pending installation manual.
controls: Centred opening used only where shown/defined by tested opening detail
